title: Removal of Genomic DNA from RNA Preparations
author: Maximilian Dietsch
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kzzcx76
materials: go to step #8 go to step #9

steps.title: Prepare DNase I Reaction
steps.instruction: Combine the following reagents in an RNase-free tube to a total volume of 10 µl:

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µl 10X reaction buffer with MgCl2
Add water to reach a final volume of 10 µl

steps.title: Incubate Reaction
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 37 °C for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Stop Reaction and Extract
steps.instruction: Stop the reaction and perform a phenol-chloroform extraction.

substeps.instruction: Add EDTA, Water, and PCI (phenol chloroform isoamyl alcohol)
Centrifuge for 10 min at 10,000 rpm and 4 °C

steps.title: Precipitate RNA
steps.instruction: Recover the RNA from the aqueous phase via precipitation.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the upper phase into a fresh tube
Add 3 volumes of EtOH/3M Natrumacetat (30:1, pH 5.2)
Centrifuge for 30 min at 13,000 rpm and 4 °C

steps.title: Wash and Dry Pellet
steps.instruction: Clean the RNA pellet and remove residual ethanol.

substeps.instruction: Wash the pellet with 75% EtOH without resuspending the pellet
Centrifuge for 10 min at 13,000 rpm and 4 °C
